quandoUsar: Actions on a message or a list item where only one needs a visible name at a time: Reply, Archive, Flag, Delete.
Quick actions that confirm on the button itself with a past-tense word, like Archive becoming Archived, with no toast.
quandoEvitar: Use `floating-button-group` or `button-group` when all labels should be visible at the same time.
Use `confirm-morph` or `hold-to-confirm` for deletions that need confirmation: here `tone="danger"` only changes the color, and the action runs on click.
Avoid on touch-only screens for urgent actions: with no hover, the first tap only reveals the label and a second one is needed to run it.

teclado.acao: Enters and leaves the group in a single stop; focus returns to the last focused action.
Move focus between actions and wrap around at the ends; the focused action expands and shows the label.
Go to the first and last action.
Run the focused action; with `doneLabel`, it confirms in place.

acessibilidade: The group is `role="toolbar"` with the required `label` and a roving tabindex; each button has an `aria-label` equal to the item's `label`, even when collapsed.
`disabled` items use `aria-disabled`, stay focusable, and show the label, so the person can discover what they would do; while the `onSelect` Promise runs, the button gets `aria-busy`.
The confirmation (`doneLabel`) is announced by a `role="status"`, including when the same action repeats.
movimento: The action under the mouse or in focus opens its width on a spring with no overshoot and the label slides out from behind the icon; the neighbors collapse, and the whole group follows the width.

On confirm, the icon becomes a checkmark that draws itself and the word swaps to `doneLabel` without changing the width, which already reserves the larger of the two; with a pending Promise, the icon pulses.
With “reduce motion”, the width changes at once, the label only fades, the icon does not shrink on press, and the wait pulse becomes a fixed opacity.
notasIA: Each item needs `id`, a short `label` (a verb), and `icon`; `onSelect` can return a Promise, and returning `false` or rejecting skips the confirmation.
`doneLabel` (“Archived”) turns on the in-place confirmation for `confirmDuration` ms (1400); omit it on actions that open something, like Reply.
One action is always expanded: `defaultExpanded` chooses which (by default, the first enabled one), and `onAction(id)` runs before the item's `onSelect`.
